actor.name: National Resistance Front of Afghanistan
actor.seat: Panjshir (fights in the north-east, notably Badakhshan; leadership reported in Tajikistan)

stances.note: Reciprocal of Afghanistan's 'adversary' stance toward National Resistance Front of Afghanistan, provisional and not yet written from this side; same evidence.

stances_toward.note: The National Resistance Front (with the Afghanistan Freedom Front and Sepahiyan-e Mihan) fights to end the Taliban's rule and the Taliban pursue it militarily: at least 50 attacks in the month to late August 2026, a district centre (Yaftali Sufla) briefly lost in July, a senior NRF commander (Hasib Panjshiri) killed in August. Claims are self-reported; the EUAA finds none holds territory. Mortal in the ontology's sense (regime vs its armed overthrow); the Taliban allege Pakistani backing for one group, Pakistan's state radio reports on the attacks without confirming support - unverified. Trend cooling: more intense fighting, Taliban losses in the north-east.

relations_to.summary: Anti-Taliban fronts claimed at least 50 attacks in the month to late August 2026, mostly in Badakhshan, Nuristan, Panjshir and the north-east; the Taliban lost a district centre (Yaftali Sufla) briefly in July, NRF commander Hasib Panjshiri was killed in August, and in September the NRF claimed two attacks in Badakhshan. Claims are self-reported and often unconfirmed.
